mapper.select: select (doc->'plan')::text as plan, doc->'org'->>'name' as name, doc->'org'->>'type' as type, (doc->'org'->'mk')::text as mk from tenant_state where tenant_id = #{tid}
select name, type from tenants where id = #{tid}
mapper.update: update tenant_state set doc = jsonb_set(jsonb_set(doc, '{org}', coalesce(doc->'org', '{}'::jsonb)), '{org,mk}', coalesce(doc->'org'->'mk', '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('pilot', #{on}::boolean)) where tenant_id = #{tid}
